scope: E52: macOS test.run OS file/network isolation, synthetic-secret functional acceptance and current-version matched off/on overhead; no model inference or cloud in timing
validation_source_change_reason: After timing, only the Stream deterministic fixture command explicitly selects CLT to avoid timestamped Xcode diagnostics. Runtime and benchmark source hashes are unchanged. Both source revisions are identified; no inference speedup is claimed.

method.baseline: Current explicit isolation off, same fixed command and minimal environment; not a reconstruction of E51 binaries
method.candidate: Default Seatbelt isolation; private TMPDIR/HOME; workspace read-only except explicit write grant for system_cc_compile_write
method.order: Alternate off/on order by repetition and case; API8 then256, CLI afterwards. File-count groups are not randomized, so do not infer causal scaling solely across groups.
method.cli_primary: Two scripted loopback HTTP model choices per task; actual agentctl registry, tool execution, receipt and final response
method.units: Milliseconds; cost = on minus off; positive means slower
method.inner_clock: C probe monotonic timer around a real child shell and command; outside-inner is computed per matched pair before aggregation
method.parent_profile: Prepare covers profile construction and bounded inode/hardlink scan; actual Seatbelt application happens in child, included with spawn/exec/polling in outside-inner
method.memory: Fixed73880-byte C job stack capacity in both current off/on; entries and populated profile bytes are not RSS, peak child memory or physical KV
method.clock_oracle: All recorded commands passed and inner timers were present; output truncation/error not hidden
method.source_scope: Source hashes describe measured revision; only later Stream fixture differs in final validation

loopback_negative_control.decision: Reject candidate; publish deny/allow only. Do not label this address filter loopback-only.

A single combined SBPL regex exceeded parser limits; replaced by bounded patterns from the same shared name tables. Initial parse failure did not run the command.
Candidate localhost filter admitted the local non-loopback receiver; reject and do not ship loopback scope.

Independent runs emitted Xcode diagnostic timestamps/PIDs, breaking canonical equality. The deterministic fixture now explicitly uses CLT and retains token/fresh-greedy assertions. Production and timing standard cc workload unchanged.

limits: Only this macOS Seatbelt backend/OS is accepted; deprecated system mechanism. Linux/Windows backends pending and default commands fail closed there.
Explicit isolation off removes OS file/network boundaries. Network allow is broad, not per-host policy. No loopback-only promise or real cloud/network quality test.
Known credentials/pattern admission still follows D-DATA; not arbitrary-secret DLP, VM isolation, hostile same-user race protection or resource-usage containment.
Metadata reads are globally allowed except protected paths; content reads remain bounded. Trusted OS/selected standard toolchain directories are read-only grants.

Standard Xcode cc has a large measured slowdown. Most paired extra time is inside command; cache/IPC causes not isolated. Explicit CLT is a separate workload, not proof of the same compiler running faster.
CLI timing includes process startup, local HTTP stubs and real tool execution; no real model decisions, inference, cloud traffic or streaming speedup claim.
Small single-machine samples, scheduling tails and negative pairs retained. Medians of phase differences must not be added together.
Private job stack capacity is shared by off/on baseline allocation, not incremental RSS. Child/system tool memory peaks and pure Seatbelt compilation time unmeasured.
Execution timeout starts after parent preparation; scan/profile work is bounded separately. Temporary cleanup failure reports io_error and does not rerun side-effecting commands.
Precompiled upstream libraries and OS programs are outside sanitizer coverage; six pre-existing native harness compiler warnings retained.
Old52 evidence files and37 figure pairs stay unchanged. E52 overhead is not added to or subtracted from older inference gains.
